proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C A' B' C' r _ _ hr h1 h2 h
  have e := EuclideanGeometry.law_cos A B C
  have e' := EuclideanGeometry.law_cos A' B' C'
  have hAC : dist A C = r * dist A' C' := by
    refine (mul_self_inj dist_nonneg (by positivity)).mp ?_
    rw [e, h1, h2, h]
    linear_combination -(r * r) * e'
  refine similar_iff_exists_pos_dist_eq.mpr ⟨r, hr, fun i j => ?_⟩
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp <;> grind [dist_comm]
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C A' B' C' : P) (r : ℝ), ¬Collinear ℝ ({A, B, C} : Set P) → ¬Collinear ℝ ({A', B', C'} : Set P) → 0 < r → dist A B = r * dist A' B' → dist C B = r * dist C' B' → EuclideanGeometry.angle A B C = EuclideanGeometry.angle A' B' C' → Similar ![A, B, C] ![A', B', C']
